# Nearby device selection sheet delay (2025-12-25 20:03Z)

_**User (2025-12-26 13:47Z)**_

when the user taps on a map region where many devices are very close to each other a sheet shows to select a specific device out of those nearby. 

Unfortunately the list of devices in this selection sheet is populated lazyly and takes some time. This makes the selection sheet come up and be empty and then getting populated after a second or two.

There seems to be an issue with the calculation and/or general data flow as this is really not something to be expected. The list should be quickly filled as obviously all those annotations have already been rendered to the map, so they are cached and available.

Analyze this specific flow around the selection of devices on the map, specifically when many devices are close on the map.

FInd the reasons why there is at all any calculation or loading / requests needed and propose optimizations and refactorings to simplify and improve the situation.

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Analyzing delay and empty sheet causes**

The device picker sheet likely appears empty because neighbor device data is computed synchronously and possibly on the main thread during or right before presentation, causing delays and a blank initial display. Heavy O(n²) computations run on every map camera change and on-demand fallback lookups on tap cause lag and stale or incomplete data. The cached coordinate updates only trigger on camera changes, not on device location updates, leading to potential staleness until next movement triggers recompute.</details></think>

---

Findings
- Nearby list is built per tap by `handleDeviceTap` using either a precomputed map or an on-demand distance scan; it then opens the sheet. The precompute is not guaranteed to be ready and the on-demand path is O(n) with lots of object creation.  
```775:809:miataru/views/iPad/Devices Views/iPad_DeviceMapView.swift
private func handleDeviceTap(deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) {
    let nearby = precomputedNearbyDevices[deviceID] ?? nearbyDevices(around: deviceID, coordinate: coordinate)
    if nearby.count > 1 {
        nearbyDevicesForPicker = nearby
        showDevicePicker = true
    } else if let first = nearby.first {
        presentActions(for: first.DeviceID)
    } else {
        presentActions(for: deviceID)
    }
}
```
- The precompute path runs every camera change on the main thread and is O(n²) (nested loop across all device coordinates). With many devices and frequent pans/zooms, it can monopolize the main thread and arrive after the sheet shows.  
```827:846:miataru/views/iPad/Devices Views/iPad_DeviceMapView.swift
private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -> [String: [KnownDevice]] {
    var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]
    let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })
    for (id, coord) in coords {
        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)
        var nearbyIDs: [String] = []
        for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {
            guard otherID != id else { continue }
            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)
            if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) <= thresholdMeters {
                nearbyIDs.append(otherID)
            }
        }
        guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }
        let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { … }).compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }
        if ordered.count > 1 { result[id] = ordered }
    }
    return result
}
```
- `refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates` is invoked on every camera change and after fetches; it rebuilds the coordinate dictionary and triggers the O(n²) computation, so pans/zooms create repeated heavy work on the main thread.
- The fallback `nearbyDevices` also walks all devices, re-creating `CLLocation` instances and sorting each tap, adding latency when the precompute is stale or not ready.

Why the sheet shows empty first
- The sheet is toggled immediately, but the data it depends on is produced by either (a) the O(n²) precompute that may still be running from recent camera changes or (b) an O(n) on-tap scan. Under load (many devices + active camera change), the main thread is busy and `nearbyDevicesForPicker` arrives late, so the sheet appears empty and fills a second later.

Optimizations / Refactors
- Move nearby computation off camera-change events. Recompute only when device locations change (i.e., when `DeviceLocationCacheStore.locations` updates) instead of every map pan/zoom. That removes the worst-case thrash.
- Build a lightweight spatial index once per location change on a background queue:
  - Keep `[String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]` plus a simple grid/bucket (e.g., 100–200m cells) or a KD-tree.
  - Precompute neighbor groups per device within threshold and publish to the views via an `ObservableObject` (e.g., `NearbyDeviceIndex.shared`).
  - Update SwiftUI state on the main thread with the finished map to avoid partial/empty lists.
- Make tap lookup constant-time:
  - `handleDeviceTap` should read the prebuilt map; if absent, do a bucketed lookup (limited set) instead of scanning all devices.
  - Ensure `nearbyDevicesForPicker` is set before toggling the sheet (already done) and consider gating the sheet on `!nearbyDevicesForPicker.isEmpty` to avoid empty presentation.
- Reduce per-tap work:
  - Cache `CLLocation` instances per device alongside coordinates to avoid recreating them repeatedly.
  - Avoid sorting on every tap; store a pre-sorted list in the precompute.
- UI polish:
  - If a recompute is forced (e.g., after a fresh location fetch), show a tiny inline progress view in the sheet until data arrives, but aim for the precompute to be ready before taps land so the sheet opens populated.
- Scope for reuse:
  - Extract shared logic from iPhone/iPad map views into a single helper/service to avoid duplicate O(n²) paths and keep behavior consistent.

and &#96;deviceStore.devices&#96;; locations are already cached before drawing markers.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    tap[MapAnnotation tap]\n    handle[handleDeviceTap]\n    precomp[precomputedNearbyDevices]\n    fallback[nearbyDevices distance scan]\n    state[nearbyDevicesForPicker + showDevicePicker]\n    sheet[Device picker sheet]\n    tap --&gt; handle\n    handle --&gt;|hit| precomp\n    handle --&gt;|miss| fallback\n    precomp --&gt; state\n    fallback --&gt; state\n    state --&gt; sheet\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n\n\n## Suspected causes for slow/empty list\n\n- O(n²) &#96;computeNearbyGroups&#96; on every camera change competes on the main thread; tap may arrive before it finishes or while it is recomputing, so sheet opens before data is ready.\n- &#96;nearbyDevices&#96; recomputes distances on demand with fresh &#96;CLLocation&#96; objects for every device; with many devices this runs on the main thread and can block initial rendering.\n- No precomputed &#96;CLLocation&#96; cache; repeated conversions and sorts per tap/camera change.\n- Work is tied to camera changes instead of location-cache changes; recalculation may lag behind the rendered annotations.\n- Sheet is shown immediately even if nearby list isn’t ready; toggling &#96;showDevicePicker&#96; can happen while precompute is still running.\n\n## Proposed improvements\n\n- **Precompute once**: Build a lightweight spatial index (grid/kd-tree) of cached coordinates keyed by &#96;DeviceID&#96; when &#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.locations&#96; changes, not on every camera change. Store nearest-neighbor groups in a dedicated manager.\n- **Constant-time tap lookup**: On tap, read the prebuilt groups; if missing, fall back to a fast grid lookup (no async, no network). Avoid per-tap distance scans over all devices.\n- **Main-thread reduction**: Move neighbor computation to a background queue and publish results to the view model; keep tap handling on main with already-ready data.\n- **UI polish**: Present sheet only after group is available (or show a tiny inline loading indicator if recompute is forced), and ensure &#96;nearbyDevicesForPicker&#96; is set before toggling the sheet.\n- **Triggering strategy**: Recompute when cached locations change (or after fetch) instead of every map pan/zoom. Keep per-camera-change work minimal.\n- **Reuse data**: Cache &#96;CLLocation&#96; per device alongside coordinates to avoid repeated object creation and sorting per tap.\n\n## Deliverables"
}

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Designing asynchronous nearby devices precompute**

I'm planning to move nearby devices computation off the main thread using a static DispatchQueue and cancellable DispatchWorkItem per view, passing a snapshot of device data to avoid thread issues. I'll add a coordinate equality check to skip redundant recomputations and trigger refreshes on cache updates via onReceive, applying similar changes in both iPhone and iPad files.</details></think>

DispatchQueue(label: \"com.miataru.nearbyCompute\", qos: .userInitiated)\n    \n    // MARK: - Offscreen arrows support types/helpers\n    private struct ArrowData {\n        let device: KnownDevice\n    var devicesByEdge: [Edge: [ArrowData]] = [:]\n        \n        // Current device\n        if let device = device, let coordinate = deviceLocation,\n           let edge = OffscreenDeviceEdgeHelper.edge(\n                for: coordinate,\n                in: region,\n                screenSize: screenSize,\n                heading: currentMapCamera?.heading ?? 0\n            ) {\n            let tap = {\n                withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.8)) {\n                    if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n                        if let currentRegion = cameraPosition.region {\n                            cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentRegion.span))\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        self.region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: self.region.span)\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\n            let centerLocation = CLLocation(latitude: region.center.latitude, longitude: region.center.longitude)\n            let distanceKM = deviceLocation.distance(from: centerLocation) / 1000.0\n            devicesByEdge[edge, default: []].append(ArrowData(device: device, coordinate: coordinate, distanceKM: distanceKM, behavior: .jumpToLocation, onTap: tap))\n        }\n        \n        // Other devices\n        if settings.showOffscreenArrowsForOtherDevices {\n            let otherDevices = deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n            for otherDevice in otherDevices {\n                if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: otherDevice.DeviceID) {\n                    let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n                    if let edge = OffscreenDeviceEdgeHelper.edge(\n                        for: coordinate,\n                        in: region,\n                        screenSize: screenSize,\n                        heading: currentMapCamera?.heading ?? 0\n                    ) {\n                        let tap: () -&gt; Void = {\n                            if let onNavigateToDevice {\n                                onNavigateToDevice(otherDevice.DeviceID)\n                            }\n                        }\n                        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\n                        let centerLocation = CLLocation(latitude: region.center.latitude, longitude: region.center.longitude)\n                        let distanceKM = deviceLocation.distance(from: centerLocation) / 1000.0\n   }\n            }\n        }\n        \n        return devicesByEdge\n    }\n    \n    // Returns true if the given coordinate lies within the provided region (handles longitude wrap-around)\n    private func isCoordinate(_ coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, inside region: MKCoordinateRegion) -&gt; Bool {\n        let halfLat = region.span.latitudeDelta / 2.0\n        let halfLon = region.span.longitudeDelta / 2.0\n        // Latitude simple bounds\n        let latOk = abs(coordinate.latitude - region.center.latitude) &lt;= halfLat\n        // Longitude shortest-arc difference (wrap-around at +/-180)\n        func shortestLongitudeDelta(_ lon1: Double, _ lon2: Double) -&gt; Double {\n            var delta = lon1 - lon2\n            while delta &gt; 180 { delta -= 360 }\n            while delta &lt; -180 { delta += 360 }\n            return delta\n        }\n        let lonDelta = abs(shortestLongitudeDelta(coordinate.longitude, region.center.longitude))\n        let lonOk = lonDelta &lt;= halfLon || region.span.longitudeDelta &gt;= 360\n        return latOk &amp;&amp; lonOk\n    }\n    \n    // Computed property to get the current device from the store\n    private var device: KnownDevice? {\n        deviceStore.devices.first { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }\n    }\n    \n    private var selectedActionDevice: KnownDevice? {\n        deviceStore.devices.first { $0.DeviceID == (selectedActionDeviceID ?? deviceID) }\n    }\n    \n    // Computed property to get the best available location for map initialization\n    private var bestAvailableLocation: CLLocationCoordinate2D {\n        // First priority: Device location (if available)\n        if let deviceLoc = deviceLocation {\n            return deviceLoc\n        }\n        \n        // Second priority: Cached device location\n        if let cached = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        }\n        \n        // Third priority: User's own location (if available and authorized)\n        if locationManager.authorizationStatus == .authorizedWhenInUse || \n           locationManager.authorizationStatus == .authorizedAlways,\n           let userLocation = locationManager.currentLocation {\n            return userLocation.coordinate\n        }\n        \n        // Fallback: Use fallback location (never returns nil)\n        return fallbackLocation\n    }\n    \n    // Computed property to get a sensible default location when no location is available\n    private var fallbackLocation: CLLocationCoordinate2D {\n        // Use user's location if available, otherwise use a central European location\n        if let userLocation = locationManager.currentLocation {\n            return userLocation.coordinate\n        }\n        \n        // Fallback to central Europe (Germany) instead of San Francisco\n        return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: 51.1657, longitude: 10.4515)\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        ZStack(alignment: .bottomTrailing) {\n            // Map and error overlay\n            VStack {\n                mapSection()\n            }\n            .background(\n                GeometryReader { geometry in\n                    Color.clear\n                        .onAppear {\n info.behavior,\n                                onTap: info.onTap\n                            )\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            \n .modifier(NavigationTitleModifier(deviceName: device?.DeviceName ?? \"Unknown Device\"))\n        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)\n        .toolbar {\n            ToolbarItem(placement: .onAppear {\n            settings.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            selectedActionDeviceID = deviceID\n            // Use preview parameters if set (for SwiftUI preview)\n            if let animatedDeviceLocation = deviceLocation\n                refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates()\n            } else {\n                // Initialize animated marker position with preview or default\n // Set initial zoom level\n            \n            // Use the best available location for map initialization\n            let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n            // Initial region set is settings.mapZoomLevel) {\n            let span = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n            // Programmatic zoom change; suppress user detection during animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 0.5)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.5)) {\n                region.span = span\n                if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n                    cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: region.center, span: span))\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        // Track map camera and region changes for heading/zoom/region state\n        .onMapCameraChange(frequency: .continuous) { context in\n            // If within suppression window, treat as programmatic and ignore interaction disabling\n            if let until = suppressUserCameraChangeDetectionUntil, Date() &lt; until {\n                currentMapCamera = context.camera\n                currentRegion = context.region\n                currentMapSpan = context.region.span\n                return\n            }\n            // Compare against previous values to track compass state\n            let headingChanged = ||\n                              abs((currentRegion?.span.longitudeDelta ?? 0) - context.region.span.longitudeDelta) &gt; 0.0001\n            if abs(context.camera.heading) &lt; 0.1 {\n 0\n                if userHasRotatedMap {\n                    Button(action: {\n                        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n                        alignMapToNorth()\n                    }) {\n                        MapCompass(heading: heading, size: 40)\n                    }\n                    .padding([.top, .trailing], 10)\n                    .zIndex(3)\n                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topTrailing)\n                    .transition(.opacity)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: userHasRotatedMap)\n    }\n    \n    @ViewBuilder\n    private func mapSection() -&gt; some View {\n        // Use the new Map API for iOS 17 and above\n        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n            Map(position: $cameraPosition,scope: mapScope) {\n                // Show device marker if location is available\n                if let coordinate = animatedDeviceLocation, let device = device {\n                    // Draw accuracy circle if enabled and accuracy is valid\n                    if settings.indicateAccuracyOnMap, let accuracy = deviceAccuracy, accuracy &gt; 0 {\n                        MapCircle(center: coordinate, radius: accuracy)\n                            .foregroundStyle(Color(device.DeviceColor ?? (pulsingSize * 1.6) / 2 + 2\n                                PulsingAccuracyCircle(pulsingColor: Color(device.DeviceColor ?? .red), size: pulsingSize)\n                                    .offset(y: VStack(spacing: 0) {\n                                // Show relative timestamp above marker (force per-second updates within Map annotation)\n                                if let timestamp = .padding(.vertical, 4)\n                                            .background(.ultraThinMaterial)\n                                            .clipShape(Capsule())\n   \n    private func nearbyDevices(around deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&gt; [KnownDevice] {\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\n            if let cached = cachedDeviceCoordinates[known.DeviceID] {\n                return (known, cached)\n            }\n            guard let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\n pair.1.longitude)\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &lt;= thresholdMeters\n        }.map { $0.0 }\n        \n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\n        \n        if let tapped {\n            return [tapped] + others\n        }\n        return others\n    }\n    \n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\n                return animated\n            }\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\n cached.longitude)\n        }\n        return nil\n    }\n\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\n        \n        for (id, coord) in coords {\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &lt;= thresholdMeters {\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\n                }\n            }\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\n \"Fetches the latest location and resets zoom if configured\")))\n    }\n    \n    // Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: String) {\n        selectedActionDeviceID = deviceID\n        showDeviceActionDialog = false\n        showEditDeviceSheet = true\n    }\n    \n    private func triggerNavigation(for deviceID: String) {\n        selectedActionDeviceID = deviceID\n        showDeviceActionDialog = false\n        showNavigationSheet = true\n    }\n    \n    private func triggerHistory(for device: KnownDevice) {\n        selectedActionDeviceID = device.DeviceID\n        showDeviceActionDialog = false\n        showHistoryView = true\n    }\n\n    private func refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates() {\n        var dict: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D] = [:]\n        if let mainCoord = deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {\n            dict[deviceID] = mainCoord\n        }\n        for other in deviceStore.devices where other.DeviceID != deviceID {\n            if let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: other.DeviceID) {\n                dict[other.DeviceID] = coord\n            }\n        }\n        cachedDeviceCoordinates = dict\n        precomputedNearbyDevices = computeNearbyGroups(from: dict)\n    }\n    \n    private func presentActions(for deviceID: String) {\n        selectedActionDeviceID = deviceID\n        showDevicePicker = false\n        showDeviceActionDialog = true\n    }\n    \n    private func handleDeviceTap(deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) {\n        let nearby = precomputedNearbyDevices[deviceID] ?? nearbyDevices(around: deviceID, coordinate: coordinate)\n        if nearby.count &gt; 1 {\n            nearbyDevicesForPicker = nearby\n            showDevicePicker = true\n        } else if let first = nearby.first {\n            presentActions(for: first.DeviceID)\n        } else {\n            presentActions(for: deviceID)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func nearbyDevices(around deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&gt; [KnownDevice] {\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\n            if let cached = cachedDeviceCoordinates[known.DeviceID] {\n                return (known, cached)\n            }\n            guard let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\n            return (known, coord)\n        }\n        \n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &lt;= thresholdMeters\n        }.map { $0.0 }\n        \n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\n        \n        if let tapped {\n            return [tapped] + others\n        }\n        return others\n    }\n    \n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\n                return animated\n            }\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\n                return current\n            }\n        }\n        if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        }\n        return nil\n    }\n\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\n        \n        for (id, coord) in coords {\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &lt;= thresholdMeters {\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\n                }\n            }\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\n            if ordered.count &gt; 1 {\n                result[id] = ordered\n            }\n        }\n        return result\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\n        isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\n        // Add generous grace period to cover chained animations and MapKit internal settling\n        suppressUserCameraChangeDetectionUntil = Date().addingTimeInterval(max(0.2, duration + 1.35))\n    }\n\n    @ViewBuilder\n    private func updateButton() -&gt; some View {\n        // Button to manually update device location\n        Button {\n            withAnimation {\n                isUpdating = true\n            }\n            Task {\n                await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: true)\n                withAnimation {\n                    isUpdating = false\n                }\n            }\n        } label: {\n            Image(systemName: \"arrow.clockwise\")\n                .symbolEffect(.rotate.clockwise.byLayer, options: .nonRepeating, isActive: isUpdating)\n        }\n        .accessibilityLabel(Text(NSLocalizedString(\"refresh_location\", comment: \"Refresh the device location now\")))\n        .accessibilityHint(Text(NSLocalizedString(\"refresh_location_hint\", comment: \"Fetches the latest location and resets zoom if configured\")))\n    }\n    \n    // Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: Bool = false) async {\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !deviceID.isEmpty else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\"Invalid server URL or DeviceID\", NSLocalizedString(\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\", comment: \"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\"))\n            return\n        }\n        let minShimmerDuration: TimeInterval = 1.5\n        let startTime = Date()\n        isLoading = true\n        defer {\n            let elapsed = Date().timeIntervalSince(startTime)\n            let remaining = minShimmerDuration - elapsed\n            if remaining &gt; 0 {\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + remaining) {\n                    isLoading = false\n                }\n            } else {\n                isLoading = false\n            }\n        }\n        do {\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceIDs: [deviceID],\n                requestingDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            )\n            if let loc = locations.first {\n                let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: loc.Latitude, longitude: loc.Longitude)\n                let coordinateChanged = deviceLocation?.latitude != coordinate.latitude || deviceLocation?.longitude != coordinate.longitude\n                deviceLocation = coordinate\n                // Update animated location immediately to ensure marker moves\n                animatedDeviceLocation = coordinate\n                deviceAccuracy = loc.HorizontalAccuracy\n                deviceTimestamp = loc.TimestampDate\n                now = Date() // Update time immediately\n                // Cache the new location including optional speed\n                DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(\n                    for: deviceID,\n                    latitude: loc.Latitude,\n                    longitude: loc.Longitude,\n                    accuracy: loc.HorizontalAccuracy,\n                    timestamp: loc.TimestampDate,\n                    batteryLevel: loc.BatteryLevel,\n                    altitude: loc.Altitude,\n                    speed: loc.Speed\n                )\n                refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates()\n                if coordinateChanged {\n                    // iPad-specific: Enhanced location change animations with explicit map movement\n                    isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\n                    withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.2)) {\n                        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\n                                // On manual update: realign map to north (heading = 0)\n                                let settingsSpan = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n                                let northCamera = MapCamera(centerCoordinate: coordinate, distance: currentMapCamera?.distance ?? 1000, heading: 0, pitch: currentMapCamera?.pitch ?? 0)\n                                cameraPosition = .camera(northCamera)\n                                currentMapSpan = settingsSpan // Also update currentMapSpan\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\n                                // On automatic update: keep current orientation (heading) but animate map movement\n                                if let currentCamera = currentMapCamera {\n                                    let newCamera = MapCamera(\n                                        centerCoordinate: coordinate,\n                                        distance: currentCamera.distance,\n                                        heading: currentCamera.heading,\n                                        pitch: currentCamera.pitch\n                                    )\n                                    cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\n                                } else {\n                                    cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentMapSpan))\n                                }\n                            }\n                        } else {\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\n                                // On manual update: use zoom level from settings\n                                let settingsSpan = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n                                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: settingsSpan)\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\n                                // On automatic update: keep current zoom level but animate map movement\n                                let currentZoomLevel = currentZoomLevelFromSpan(region.span)\n                                let currentSpan = spanForZoomLevel(currentZoomLevel)\n                                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentSpan)\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                showErrorOverlay(\"No location data found\", NSLocalizedString(\"no_location_data_found\", comment: \"No location available\"))\n            }\n        } catch let error as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\n            // Differentiated error handling\n            switch error {\n            case .invalidURL:\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Invalid server URL\", NSLocalizedString(\"server_url_invalid\", comment: \"The server URL is invalid.\"))\n            case .invalidResponse(_):\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Invalid server response\", NSLocalizedString(\"server_response_invalid\", comment: \"The server response was invalid.\"))\n            case .encodingError(let err):\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Encoding error: \\(err.localizedDescription)\", NSLocalizedString(\"encoding_error\", comment: \"Error encoding the request.\"))\n            case .decodingError(let err):\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Error processing the response: \\(err.localizedDescription)\", NSLocalizedString(\"decoding_error\", comment: \"Error processing the server response.\"))\n            case .requestFailed(_):\n                // Show only the network error icon, not the overlay\n                withAnimation {\n                    showNetworkErrorIcon = true\n                }\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2) {\n                    withAnimation {\n                        showNetworkErrorIcon = false\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            showErrorOverlay(error.localizedDescription, NSLocalizedString(\"error_loading_locationdata\", comment: \"Error loading location data\"))\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        guard interval &gt; 0 else { return }\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\n            .autoconnect()\n            .sink { _ in\n                Task { await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: false) }\n            }\n    }\n\n    // Stops the auto-update timer\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\n        timerCancellable = nil\n    }\n\n    // Restarts the auto-update timer\n    private func restartAutoUpdate() {\n        startAutoUpdate()\n    }\n\n    // Shows the error overlay with a debug and user message\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\n        debugLog(\"Error: \\(debugMessage)\")\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\n    }\n\n    // Aligns the map to north (heading = 0)\n    private func alignMapToNorth() {\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n        guard let currentCamera = currentMapCamera else { return }\n        let newCamera = MapCamera(\n            centerCoordinate: coordinate,\n            distance: currentCamera.distance,\n            heading: 0, // North\n            pitch: currentCamera.pitch\n        )\n        // iPad-specific: Enhanced compass alignment animation\n        beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n        withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n            cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\n            userHasRotatedMap = false // Hide compass when aligned to north\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Resets the map zoom to the value from settings\n    private func resetZoomToSettings() {\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        let span = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n            let newRegion = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\n                currentMapSpan = span\n            }\n        } else {\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            }\n        }\n\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Visible devices calculation (iOS 17+)\nextension iPad_DeviceMapView {\n    private func updateVisibleDeviceCount(with region: MKCoordinateRegion?) {\n        guard let region = region else {\n            visibleDeviceCount = 0\n            return\n        }\n        var count = 0\n        // Main device\n        if let coord = animatedDeviceLocation, isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n            count += 1\n        }\n        // Other devices shown on the map (when inside the viewport)\n        let others = deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n        for other in others {\n            if let cached function schedulePrecompute() {

Implemented the plan and optimized the nearby-device sheet flow.

- Added background precomputation for nearby devices with cancelable work items and reuse of cached coordinates; computation now triggers on location-cache changes instead of camera panning, avoiding main-thread stalls.
```860:875:miataru/views/iPad/Devices Views/iPad_DeviceMapView.swift
    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {
        let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })
        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()
        let currentItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, weak self] in
            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)
            DispatchQueue.main.async {
                guard let self else { return }
                guard let active = self.nearbyComputeWorkItem, active === currentItem else { return }
                self.precomputedNearbyDevices = groups
            }
        }
        nearbyComputeWorkItem = currentItem
        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: currentItem)
    }
```
- Short-circuited redundant recomputations when coordinates are unchanged and reused cached data for tap handling, reducing per-tap work.
```755:772:miataru/views/iPad/Devices Views/iPad_DeviceMapView.swift
    private func refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates() {
        var dict: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D] = [:]
        if let mainCoord = deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {
            dict[deviceID] = mainCoord
        }
        for other in deviceStore.devices where other.DeviceID != deviceID {
            if let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: other.DeviceID) {
                dict[other.DeviceID] = coord
            }
        }
        if coordinatesEqual(lhs: cachedDeviceCoordinates, rhs: dict) {
            return
        }
        cachedDeviceCoordinates = dict
        scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with: dict)
    }
```
- Hooked into `cache.$locations` so nearby lists stay aligned with cached annotation data and the sheet opens with ready data on both iPhone and iPad. The same background precompute flow and guards were applied in `iPhone_DeviceMapView.swift`.

What to verify
- Open map with many nearby devices; tapping a cluster should show the sheet already populated.
- Pan/zoom rapidly; nearby list should stay responsive without visible lag.
- Confirm no regressions in device actions sheet and navigation/history flows.

let newCamera = MapCamera(\n                                        centerCoordinate: coordinate,\n                                        distance: currentCamera.distance,\n                                        heading: currentCamera.heading,\n                                        pitch: currentCamera.pitch\n                                    )\n                                    cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\n                                } else {\n                                    cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: isLoading = false\n            }\n        }\n        do {\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceIDs: CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: loc.Latitude, longitude: loc.Longitude)\n                let coordinateChanged = deviceLocation?.latitude != coordinate.latitude || deviceLocation?.longitude != coordinate.longitude\n                deviceLocation = coordinate\n                // Update animated location immediately to ensure marker moves\n                animatedDeviceLocation = coordinate\n                deviceAccuracy = loc.HorizontalAccuracy\n                deviceTimestamp = loc.TimestampDate\n                now = Date() // Update time immediately\n                // Cache the new location including optional speed\n                DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(\n                    for: deviceID,\n                    latitude: loc.Latitude,\n                    longitude: loc.Longitude,\n                    accuracy: loc.HorizontalAccuracy,\n                    timestamp: loc.TimestampDate,\n                    batteryLevel: loc.BatteryLevel,\n cameraPosition = .camera(northCamera)\n                                currentMapSpan = settingsSpan // Also update currentMapSpan\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\n                                // On automatic update: keep current orientation (heading)\n                                if let currentCamera = currentMapCamera {\n                                    let newCamera = MapCamera(\n                                        centerCoordinate: coordinate,\n                                        distance: currentCamera.distance,\n                                        heading: currentCamera.heading,\n                                        pitch: currentCamera.pitch\n                                    )\n                                    cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\n                                } else {\n                                    cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentMapSpan))\n                                }\n                            }\n                        } else {\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\n MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: settingsSpan)\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\n                                // On automatic update: keep current zoom level\n                                let currentZoomLevel = currentZoomLevelFromSpan(region.span)\n                                let currentSpan = spanForZoomLevel(currentZoomLevel)\n else {\n                showErrorOverlay(\"No location data found\", NSLocalizedString(\"no_location_data_found\", comment: \"No location available\"))\n            }\n        } catch let error as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\n            // Differentiated error handling\n            switch error {\n            case .invalidURL:\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Invalid server URL\", NSLocalizedString(\"server_url_invalid\", comment: \"The server URL is invalid.\"))\n            case .invalidResponse(_):\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Invalid server response\", NSLocalizedString(\"server_response_invalid\", comment: \"The server response was invalid.\"))\n            case .encodingError(let err):\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Encoding error: \\(err.localizedDescription)\", NSLocalizedString(\"encoding_error\", comment: \"Error encoding the request.\"))\n            case .decodingError(let err):\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Error processing the response: \\(err.localizedDescription)\", NSLocalizedString(\"decoding_error\", comment: \"Error processing the server response.\"))\n            case .requestFailed(_):\n DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2) {\n                    withAnimation {\n                        showNetworkErrorIcon = false\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            showErrorOverlay(error.localizedDescription, NSLocalizedString(\"error_loading_locationdata\", comment: \"Error loading location data\"))\n        }\n    }\n\n    // deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {\n            dict[deviceID] = mainCoord\n        }\n        for other in deviceStore.devices where other.DeviceID != deviceID {\n            if let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: other.DeviceID) {\n                dict[other.DeviceID] = coord\n            }\n        }\n        // Avoid redundant work if coordinates did not change\n        if coordinate.longitude)\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\n            if let cached = return (known, coord)\n        }\n        \n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: deviceID })\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\n        \n &gt; 1 {\n                result[id] = ordered\n            }\n        }\n        return result\n    }\n\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\n String) {\n        selectedActionDeviceID = deviceID\n        showDeviceActionDialog = false\n        showEditDeviceSheet = true\n    }\n    \n    private func triggerNavigation(for deviceID: String) {\n        selectedActionDeviceID = deviceID\n        showDeviceActionDialog = false\n        showNavigationSheet = true\n    }\n    \n    private func triggerHistory(for device: KnownDevice) {\n        selectedActionDeviceID = device.DeviceID\n        showDeviceActionDialog = false\n        showHistoryView = true\n    }\n\n    private func refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates() {\n        var dict: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D] = [:]\n        if let mainCoord = deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {\n            dict[deviceID] = mainCoord\n        }\n        for other in deviceStore.devices where other.DeviceID != deviceID {\n            if let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: other.DeviceID) {\n                dict[other.DeviceID] = coord\n            }\n        }\n        // Avoid redundant recomputation if coordinates have not changed\n        if coordinatesEqual(lhs: cachedDeviceCoordinates, rhs: dict) {\n            return\n        }\n        cachedDeviceCoordinates = dict\n        scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with: dict)\n    }\n    \n    private func presentActions(for deviceID: String) {\n        selectedActionDeviceID = deviceID\n        showDevicePicker = false\n        showDeviceActionDialog = true\n    }\n    \n    private func handleDeviceTap(deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) {\n        let nearby = precomputedNearbyDevices[deviceID] ?? nearbyDevices(around: deviceID, coordinate: coordinate)\n        if nearby.count &gt; 1 {\n            nearbyDevicesForPicker = nearby\n            showDevicePicker = true\n        } else if let first = nearby.first {\n            presentActions(for: first.DeviceID)\n        } else {\n            presentActions(for: deviceID)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func nearbyDevices(around deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&gt; [KnownDevice] {\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\n            if let cached = cachedDeviceCoordinates[known.DeviceID] {\n                return (known, cached)\n            }\n            guard let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\n            return (known, coord)\n        }\n        \n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &lt;= thresholdMeters\n        }.map { $0.0 }\n        \n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\n        \n        if let tapped {\n            return [tapped] + others\n        }\n        return others\n    }\n    \n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\n                return animated\n            }\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\n                return current\n            }\n        }\n        if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        }\n        return nil\n    }\n\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\n        \n        for (id, coord) in coords {\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &lt;= thresholdMeters {\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\n                }\n            }\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\n            if ordered.count &gt; 1 {\n                result[id] = ordered\n            }\n        }\n        return result\n    }\n\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\n        let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\n        let currentItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0] in\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\n            DispatchQueue.main.async { [currentItem] in\n                guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, active === currentItem else { return }\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\n            }\n        }\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = currentItem\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: currentItem)\n    }\n\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) -&gt; Bool {\n        guard lhs.count == rhs.count else { return false }\n        for (key, value) in lhs {\n            guard let other = rhs[key] else { return false }\n            if abs(value.latitude - other.latitude) &gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\n            if abs(value.longitude - other.longitude) &gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\n        }\n        return true\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\n        isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\n        // Add generous grace period to cover chained animations and MapKit internal settling\n        suppressUserCameraChangeDetectionUntil = Date().addingTimeInterval(max(0.2, duration + 1.35))\n    }\n\n    @ViewBuilder\n    private func updateButton() -&gt; some View {\n        // Button to manually update device location\n        Button {\n            withAnimation {\n                isUpdating = true\n            }\n            Task {\n                await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: true)\n                withAnimation {\n                    isUpdating = false\n                }\n            }\n        } label: {\n            Image(systemName: \"arrow.clockwise\")\n                .symbolEffect(.rotate.clockwise.byLayer, options: .nonRepeating, isActive: isUpdating)\n        }\n        .accessibilityLabel(Text(NSLocalizedString(\"refresh_location\", comment: \"Refresh the device location now\")))\n        .accessibilityHint(Text(NSLocalizedString(\"refresh_location_hint\", comment: \"Fetches the latest location and resets zoom if configured\")))\n    }\n    \n    // Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: Bool = false) async {\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !deviceID.isEmpty else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\"Invalid server URL or DeviceID\", NSLocalizedString(\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\", comment: \"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\"))\n            return\n        }\n        let minShimmerDuration: TimeInterval = 1.5\n        let startTime = Date()\n        isLoading = true\n        defer {\n            let elapsed = Date().timeIntervalSince(startTime)\n            let remaining = minShimmerDuration - elapsed\n            if remaining &gt; 0 {\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + remaining) {\n                    isLoading = false\n                }\n            } else {\n                isLoading = false\n            }\n        }\n        do {\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceIDs: [deviceID],\n                requestingDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            )\n            if let loc = locations.first {\n                let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: loc.Latitude, longitude: loc.Longitude)\n                let coordinateChanged = deviceLocation?.latitude != coordinate.latitude || deviceLocation?.longitude != coordinate.longitude\n                deviceLocation = coordinate\n                // Update animated location immediately to ensure marker moves\n                animatedDeviceLocation = coordinate\n                deviceAccuracy = loc.HorizontalAccuracy\n                deviceTimestamp = loc.TimestampDate\n                now = Date() // Update time immediately\n                // Cache the new location including optional speed\n                DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(\n                    for: deviceID,\n                    latitude: loc.Latitude,\n                    longitude: loc.Longitude,\n                    accuracy: loc.HorizontalAccuracy,\n                    timestamp: loc.TimestampDate,\n                    batteryLevel: loc.BatteryLevel,\n                    altitude: loc.Altitude,\n                    speed: loc.Speed\n                )\n                refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates()\n                if coordinateChanged {\n                    // iPad-specific: Enhanced location change animations with explicit map movement\n                    isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\n                    withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.2)) {\n                        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\n                                // On manual update: realign map to north (heading = 0)\n                                let settingsSpan = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n                                let northCamera = MapCamera(centerCoordinate: coordinate, distance: currentMapCamera?.distance ?? 1000, heading: 0, pitch: currentMapCamera?.pitch ?? 0)\n                                cameraPosition = .camera(northCamera)\n                                currentMapSpan = settingsSpan // Also update currentMapSpan\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\n                                // On automatic update: keep current orientation (heading) but animate map movement\n                                if let currentCamera = currentMapCamera {\n                                    let newCamera = MapCamera(\n                                        centerCoordinate: coordinate,\n                                        distance: currentCamera.distance,\n                                        heading: currentCamera.heading,\n                                        pitch: currentCamera.pitch\n                                    )\n                                    cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\n                                } else {\n                                    cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentMapSpan))\n                                }\n                            }\n                        } else {\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\n                                // On manual update: use zoom level from settings\n                                let settingsSpan = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n                                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: settingsSpan)\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\n                                // On automatic update: keep current zoom level but animate map movement\n                                let currentZoomLevel = currentZoomLevelFromSpan(region.span)\n                                let currentSpan = spanForZoomLevel(currentZoomLevel)\n                                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentSpan)\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                showErrorOverlay(\"No location data found\", NSLocalizedString(\"no_location_data_found\", comment: \"No location available\"))\n            }\n        } catch let error as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\n            // Differentiated error handling\n            switch error {\n            case .invalidURL:\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Invalid server URL\", NSLocalizedString(\"server_url_invalid\", comment: \"The server URL is invalid.\"))\n            case .invalidResponse(_):\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Invalid server response\", NSLocalizedString(\"server_response_invalid\", comment: \"The server response was invalid.\"))\n            case .encodingError(let err):\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Encoding error: \\(err.localizedDescription)\", NSLocalizedString(\"encoding_error\", comment: \"Error encoding the request.\"))\n            case .decodingError(let err):\n                showErrorOverlay(\"Error processing the response: \\(err.localizedDescription)\", NSLocalizedString(\"decoding_error\", comment: \"Error processing the server response.\"))\n            case .requestFailed(_):\n                // Show only the network error icon, not the overlay\n                withAnimation {\n                    showNetworkErrorIcon = true\n                }\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2) {\n                    withAnimation {\n                        showNetworkErrorIcon = false\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            showErrorOverlay(error.localizedDescription, NSLocalizedString(\"error_loading_locationdata\", comment: \"Error loading location data\"))\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        guard interval &gt; 0 else { return }\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\n            .autoconnect()\n            .sink { _ in\n                Task { await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: false) }\n            }\n    }\n\n    // Stops the auto-update timer\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\n        timerCancellable = nil\n    }\n\n    // Restarts the auto-update timer\n    private func restartAutoUpdate() {\n        startAutoUpdate()\n    }\n\n    // Shows the error overlay with a debug and user message\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\n        debugLog(\"Error: \\(debugMessage)\")\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\n    }\n\n    // Aligns the map to north (heading = 0)\n    private func alignMapToNorth() {\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n        guard let currentCamera = currentMapCamera else { return }\n        let newCamera = MapCamera(\n            centerCoordinate: coordinate,\n            distance: currentCamera.distance,\n            heading: 0, // North\n            pitch: currentCamera.pitch\n        )\n        // iPad-specific: Enhanced compass alignment animation\n        beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n        withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n            cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\n            userHasRotatedMap = false // Hide compass when aligned to north\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Resets the map zoom to the value from settings\n    private func resetZoomToSettings() {\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        let span = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n            let newRegion = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\n )\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\n        isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\n isLoading = false\n            }\n        }\n        do {\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceIDs: coordinate.longitude\n                deviceLocation = coordinate\n                // Update animated location immediately to ensure marker moves\n                animatedDeviceLocation = coordinate\n                deviceAccuracy = loc.HorizontalAccuracy\n                deviceTimestamp = loc.TimestampDate\n                now = Date() // Update time immediately\n                // Cache the new location including optional speed\n                DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(\n                    for: deviceID,\n                    latitude: loc.Latitude,\n                    longitude: loc.Longitude,\n                    accuracy: loc.HorizontalAccuracy,\n                    timestamp: loc.TimestampDate,\n                    batteryLevel: loc.BatteryLevel,\n beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 0.8)\n                    withAnimation {\n                        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\n      let northCamera = MapCamera(centerCoordinate: coordinate, distance: currentMapCamera?.distance ?? 1000, heading: 0, pitch: currentMapCamera?.pitch ?? 0)\n                                cameraPosition = .camera(northCamera)\n                                currentMapSpan = settingsSpan // Also update currentMapSpan\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\n                                // On automatic update: keep current orientation (heading)\n                                if let currentCamera = currentMapCamera {\n                                    let newCamera = MapCamera(\n                                        centerCoordinate: coordinate,\n                                        distance: currentCamera.distance,\n                                        heading: currentCamera.heading,\n                                        pitch: currentCamera.pitch\n                                    )\n                                    cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\n                                } else {\n                                    cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: level\n                                let currentZoomLevel = currentZoomLevelFromSpan(region.span)\n                                let currentSpan = spanForZoomLevel(currentZoomLevel)\n
